title: Peanut Tofu Rice Bowl
style: Warm rice and baked tofu with edamame, cucumber and avocado, drizzled with a quick peanut sauce and finished with sesame seeds and crispy onions
description: Baked tofu, rice, edamame and fresh veg with a stir-together peanut sauce, topped with sesame seeds and crispy onions. Ready in about 15 minutes — about 920 kcal and 45 g protein per serving.
steps: Cook the edamame: Put the frozen edamame in a bowl with a splash of water, cover and microwave for 3–4 minutes until hot, then drain. (Or boil for 3 minutes.)
Warm rice and tofu: Microwave the rice until hot, about 2–3 minutes. Warm the baked tofu alongside for 1 minute if it's cold.

Make the sauce: Stir together the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice or rice vinegar, honey or maple syrup and sriracha or chili crisp. Add the hot water a little at a time until smooth and pourable.
Prep the veg: Slice the cucumber, avocado and spring onions.
Build the bowls: Divide the rice between two bowls, then top with the tofu, edamame, cucumber and avocado. Drizzle with the peanut sauce.
Finish: Scatter over the spring onions, sesame seeds and crispy onions, and squeeze a lime wedge over each bowl.
tips: For extra tang, toss the cucumber in a splash of rice vinegar with a pinch of salt and sugar while you make the sauce.
Use maple syrup instead of honey to keep it vegan.
Add the crispy onions right before eating so they stay crunchy.
